notes.title: Humble Holiday Horrors V1.0.1
notes.content:
A bunch of small visual tweaks!
-When blinking is paused, its icon has an outline.
-[spoiler]1203's totems now highlight things that they're currently having an effect over. [/spoiler]
-Reduced swaying of some UI button text.
-Pink Lemonade game now has a link on the title screen.
-JOY now has chilly breath when she jumpscares you from in the pantry.
-Title screen and mode select now have falling snow in the background.
-Backing out of Sandbox mode now sends you back to mode select, not title screen.

notes.title: PINK LEMONADE
notes.content:
[b]Happy (belated) Valentines Day! For a holiday meant for the truest and purest of loves, I've decided to release PINK LEMONADE![/b]

It's is a free Humble Holiday Horror spinoff that can be played on the web! It's a simple yet unique experience where you need to match cards against your titular opponent, each turn getting riskier than the last. it has lots of extra to buy for both cosmetic, difficulty increases, and additional story!

You can find it on itch.io [i][b][url=https://shoe-stealin-studio.itch.io/pink-lemonade]HERE![/url][/b][/i]

If you're interested in extra score codes, there are two available on the [url=https://discord.gg/CuDv73h5tF]Discord [/url]and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/shoestealin.bsky.social]BSky[/url].
